changes_made.explanation: Removed all metadata as GPT-2 is used as a language model scorer during generation process, not as a judge after generation. This does not qualify as LLM-as-judge evaluation.
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper.

overall_notes: The paper presents a data-to-text generation system using iterative text editing with LaserTagger and GPT-2 for fluency scoring. It evaluates on WebNLG and E2E datasets using standard NLG metrics but does not conduct human evaluation or use LLMs as judges. The extraction was generally accurate but included some models mentioned only in related work.
